org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.business

Class ComputationLibraryImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.business.ComputationLibraryImpl

  • public class ComputationLibraryImpl
extends Object
    The computation library session EJB; this class contains all the methods that PEAS-PCS uses to perform all computations, either implemented in FORTRAN or Java. When an executor object needs to call a computation, this is the EJB whose methods are called to accomplish this. The methods in this EJB will delegate computations to FORTRAN library routines or to JavaComputations.
    Author:
    smichaels
    See Also:
    JavaComputations

      • findCent

        @Computation
public FindCentResult findCent(float[][] frame,
                                  FloatPoint guess,
                                  FindCentConfig findCentConfig,
                                  int nspotType)
                        throws ComputationException
        Compute the centroid using a center of mass or Gaussian fit method. This method calls the FORTRAN function in findCent.f90
        Parameters:
        frame - Full image array containing subimages to be centroided.
        guess - original guess for centroid
        findCentConfig - configuration for find cent, containing irad, imargin, itermax, and ngauss
        nspotType - Spot type to determine how the background is computed: 2 for peripheral spots; 1 for non-peripheral spots.
        Returns:
        result class containing original guess, computed centroid, intensities and findCent status flag
        Throws:
        ComputationException

      • findCentroids

        @Computation
public FindCentroidsResult findCentroids(float[][] frame,
                                            FIResult fiResult,
                                            FindCentConfig findCentConfigInterior,
                                            FindCentConfig findCentConfigPeripheral,
                                            int[] nspotTypes,
                                            int[] missingSpotFlags,
                                            boolean findAllMaskSpots)
                                  throws ComputationException
        Calls findCent for multiple passed in centroid guesses. This method calls the FORTRAN function in findCentroid.f90
        Parameters:
        frame - Full image array containing subimages to be centroided.
        fiResult - result class returned from calling findAndIdentify function
        findCentConfigInterior - findCent configuration for this mask type to be used for interior spots. FindCentConfig is configuration for find cent, containing irad, imargin, itermax, and ngauss
        findCentConfigPeripheral - findCent configuration for this mask type to be used for peripheral spots. FindCentConfig is configuration for find cent, containing irad, imargin, itermax, and ngauss
        nspotTypes - array of spot types for background computation (2=peripheral spot; 1=other).
        missingSpotFlags - array of flags indicating if a spot is expected to be present and if it is to be used in analysis.
        findAllMaskSpots - override of missing spots, if true all spots should be found. Typically true for reference beam frames.
        Returns:
        result class containing computed centroid, intensities and findCent status flag for all centroids attempted to be found
        Throws:
        ComputationException

      • findAndIdentify

        public FIResult findAndIdentify(float[][] frame,
                       int numSpots,
                       FIConfig fiConfig,
                       RefBeamMap currentRefMap,
                       List<FloatPoint> refDefCentroids,
                       int[] missingSpotFlags,
                       boolean findAllMaskSpots)
                         throws ComputationException
        Find and Identify all of the sub-images in a CCD frame. This method calls the FORTRAN function in findAndIdentify.f90.
        Parameters:
        frame - CCD Frame to find sub-images in
        numSpots - the number of spots to find
        fiConfig - findAndIdentify computation configuration. See FIConfig and findAndIdentify.f90 for complete descriptions.
        currentRefMap - the reference beam map to use to force scale and rotation of image, if specified in the configuration
        refDefCentroids - the ideal locations of the centroids to find
        missingSpotFlags - array of flags indicating if a spot is expected and if it will be used for analysis
        findAllMaskSpots - missing spots override, if true find all spots. Typically true for reference beam frames.
        Returns:
        result class. Descriptions of each field are in the header descriptions in findAndIdentify.f90.
        Throws:
        ComputationException

      • calculateCentroidOffsets

        @Computation
public CentroidOffsetsResult calculateCentroidOffsets(FloatPoint[] centroids,
                                                         FloatPoint[] refMapCentroids,
                                                         CentroidOffsetsConfig centroidOffsetsConfig,
                                                         PupilMaskType pupilMaskType,
                                                         int[] nspotTypes,
                                                         int[] missingSpotFlags,
                                                         int[] findCentStatusList)
                                               throws ComputationException
        Calculates centroid offsets given an array of centroids and reference map centroids
        Parameters:
        centroids - the array of centroids to find the offsets of
        refMapCentroids - the reference map of centroids to find the offsets from
        centroidOffsetsConfig - rotation removal and scale removal flags
        pupilMaskType - the type of mask that produced the centroids (e.g. Fine Screen, Passive Tilt, etc)
        nspotTypes - array of flags indicating if a spot is interior or peripheral
        missingSpotFlags - array of flags indicating if a spot is to be used for this analysis
        findCentStatusList - an array of flags indicating if/how this spot was found during find and identify
        Returns:
        a result object containing the offsets in ccd and cartesian coordinates, the image translation, rotation and scale, and which spots were actually used in the analysis.
        Throws:
        ComputationException - if the Fortran routine returns an error code

      • bbAnalyzeSequence

        @Computation
public BbAnalyzeSequenceResult bbAnalyzeSequence(int[] edgeAngle,
                                                    int[] edgeColor,
                                                    float[][] coherenceArraySet,
                                                    float stepSize,
                                                    int numSegments,
                                                    int[] plusPiston,
                                                    int[] minusPiston,
                                                    float ringModeCorrectionFactor,
                                                    int[] mirrorConfig,
                                                    Filter filter,
                                                    float bbPhasingFracInterval,
                                                    float[] ringMode,
                                                    int numSteps,
                                                    int[] useForAnalysis,
                                                    int[] goodSpots)
                                          throws Exception
        Fit the coherence curves to determine the edge heights and do the SVD to determine the pistons.
        Parameters:
        edgeAngle - array of edge angles defined for each phasing edge (0, 120, or 240 degrees).
        edgeColor - array of three-Color-Mode edge color defined for each phasing edge (1, 2, or 3)
        coherenceArraySet - coherence parameters for all phasing spots and all exposures
        stepSize - phasing step size
        numSegments - number of primary mirror segments
        plusPiston - used to create the phasing control matrix (nedges x nsegments)
        minusPiston - used to create the phasing control matrix (nedges x nsegments)
        ringModeCorrectionFactor - the magnitude of ring-mode correction to apply to the measured edge heights
        mirrorConfig - logical array indicating active segments
        filter - contains the input sigma of coherence parameter
        bbPhasingFracInterval - the fractional interval size to use for chi-square analysis
        ringMode - array of ring-mode edges with unit rms (where the averaging is over the 78 edges from 7 thru 84).
        numSteps - number of phasing steps
        useForAnalysis - array of flags indicating if a spot can be used for analysis
        goodSpots - array of flags indicating if the spot was found
        Returns:
        result object containing: measured edge heights after correcting for the dispersion effect of the prisms, computed segment piston commands, Predicted residual edge heights that are expected after applying the calculated segment piston commands, array of flags specifying which edges had good edge height measurements (0=bad, 1=good), number of constrained segments and RMS of segment piston commands, Best fit coherences for each edge (microns), Mean of the best fit coherences for good edges (microns)
        Throws:
        ComputationException - if the Fortran routine returns an error code
        Exception

      • calculateSufsZernikes

        @Computation
public SufsSegmentZernikeResult calculateSufsZernikes(FloatPoint[] sufsSegmentIdealSpotLocations,
                                                         FloatPoint[][] segmentOffsets,
                                                         float aHex,
                                                         float secPerPixel,
                                                         int[][] validOffsets,
                                                         int[][] sufsGroupSegmentToMask,
                                                         int[] sufsZernikeOrder,
                                                         int[] groupSegmentNumbers)
                                               throws Exception
        Calculates SUFS Zernikes for each segment in the SUFS group.
        Parameters:
        sufsSegmentIdealSpotLocations - ideal subaperature locations for a segment
        segmentOffsets - centroid offsets for each spot of each of the seven SUFS group segments
        aHex - hexagon side length in meters
        secPerPixel - converts pixels to arcseconds
        validOffsets - flag specifying which subapertures per segment to use in the Zernike calculation
        sufsGroupSegmentToMask - mapping of sufs group segment spot number to mask spot number, used to reorder mask numbered arrays into seven segment spot numbered arrays
        sufsZernikeOrder - array of zernike orders to calculate ordered by segment number
        groupSegmentNumbers - array of segment numbers for this SUFS group
        Returns:
        result object containing the following zernike related information for each segment: the best-fit Zernike coefficients computed from the given centroid offsets, The fraction of the RMS-squared centroid offsets (i.e. power) that is represented by the fitted Zernike coefficients and the theoretical centroid offsets corresponding to the fitted Zernike coefficients.
        Throws:
        Exception
